description: Use this when the agent or app should be notified immediately (HTTP POST) when mail arrives instead of polling cooper_list_messages. Requires auth. Inputs: url (required; public http or https URL; localhost and private addresses are rejected), events (optional; any of message.received, message.held, message.sent, message.blocked, message.bounced, message.complained, task.received, owner.reply, domain.verified, draft.created, draft.approved, draft.rejected, draft.sent, account.sending_paused, account.sending_resumed, thread.assigned, thread.unassigned, thread.folder_updated, question.answered, question.expired; default [message.received]), inbox_id (optional; one inbox) or inbox_ids (optional; at most 10 inbox ids; omit both for every inbox), client_id (optional idempotency key; the same value returns the original hook with HTTP 200 and a redacted secret), headers (optional; up to 5 extra headers named Authorization or X-*, stored encrypted and never returned in full). Returns {id, url, events, inbox_id, inbox_ids, enabled, secret, headers (redacted), created_at}. Each delivery sends x-cooper-signature (sha256= HMAC of the raw body) and x-cooper-signature-v2 (v1= HMAC of timestamp, a dot, and the raw body) plus x-cooper-timestamp. message.blocked fires when an allow or block list drops inbound mail before it is stored. Fails with 400 too_many_inboxes, 400 invalid_url, or 404 inbox_not_found.

client_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same client_id returns the original hook with the secret redacted.

headers.description: Up to 5 extra headers sent on delivery. Names must be Authorization or X-*. Values are stored encrypted and never returned in full.

inbox_id.description: Only deliver events for this inbox. Stored into inbox_ids. Omit for every inbox on the account.

inbox_ids.description: Up to 10 inbox ids. The hook matches when this list is empty or contains the event inbox. More than 10 returns 400 too_many_inboxes.

url.description: Public https URL that receives POST deliveries

name: cooper_register_webhook

outputSchema.description: The new webhook. The secret is shown in full once.

client_id.description: Caller idempotency key stored with the object, or null.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

disabled_at.description: ISO-8601 time Cooper disabled the hook, or null.

disabled_reason.description: Why the hook was disabled, or null.

enabled.description: True when the object is active.

headers.description: Extra delivery headers. Values are redacted.

id.description: Stable id of the returned object. Pass it to the matching get, update, or delete tool.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

inbox_ids.description: Inbox ids this object is limited to. Empty means every inbox on the account.

previous_secret_active.description: True while deliveries are also signed with the previous secret.

previous_secret_expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time the previous secret stops signing, or null.

secret.description: Signing secret. Shown in full once on create or rotate, redacted otherwise.

title: Register webhook
